text_block_list.text:
During an interview, Ines Fujin<n>confidently
reaffirms her goal of<n>winning the Japanese Derby
as the<n>most popular Umamusume.

We've worked towards this dream<n>together, and
the deep trust we share<n>has left her with an
unwavering<n>resolve. That much is clear from the
look in her eyes.

Mejiro Ryan has also been spurred<n>onward by
Ines Fujin's efforts. She<n>explains that watching
Ines helped<n>her to bring her own dream into focus.

But Ines Fujin has a dream of her<n>own, and it's
one she means to<n>realize. After all, her sisters have
come to the Japanese Derby to cheer<n>her on!
